title: Project P.I.T.T.: 3 Fuses, Fuse Box UP? and Next Step
description: Three fuses must be placed in the Fuse Box in an upper/catwalk (right-side elevated) area; completing the fuse step leads into the 200kg weight puzzle next.
h1: Project P.I.T.T.: 3 Fuses, Fuse Box UP? and Next Step
quickAnswer: There are 3 fuses that must all be inserted into the Fuse Box located in an upper/catwalk (right-side/elevated) area; placing all three completes the fuse step, progresses to the 200kg puzzle, and is tied to UP? by community reports.

facts.label: Fuses required
facts.value: Three fuses are required by the Fuse Box.

facts.label: Fuse Box location
facts.value: The Fuse Box sits in an upper/catwalk, right-side or otherwise elevated portion of the facility.

facts.label: Insertion requirement
facts.value: You must insert all three fuses into the Fuse Box; finding the box alone does not complete progression.

facts.label: After completion
facts.value: Completing the fuse progression leads into the 200kg weight/scale progression; UP? is a Steam achievement that community reports consistently connect to this step.
